messages:
kevin: Hi! Day 1. Okta login worked but Google Drive shows "No access" when I try the onboarding folder. Weirdly I can access other public docs. Who should I ping?
sara_it: @kevin can you confirm you're using kevin@redwood.ai and not your old alias? Also paste exact error text if possible.
kevin: Using kevin@redwood.ai. Error: "You need permission" and button says Request access but that just spins.
marco: Could be folder ACLs or the Drive group mapping. @sara_it can you check rw-onboard-group?
onboard_bot: onboard_bot: created onboarding ticket #ONB-4321 for kevin (auto-assigned to it-queue).
sara_it: I see the group, but kevin was missing from rw-onboarders in Google groups due to alias mismatch (kevin.work vs kevin). Re-syncing now.
sara_it: Re-sync complete. Try again in 30s.
kevin: Still stuck. I notice my Chrome profile defaulted to my personal account and it keeps switching. Trying incognito makes the permission dialog show the corporate address though.
marco: Chrome profile switching will do that. Sign into the profile with kevin@redwood.ai or use the Chrome profile picker. Incognito is fine for now.
kevin: Ok that worked, I can see the folder now. Thanks. One more: I got the 1Password invite to kevin.oldalias@personal.com instead of my corporate email.
elaine: Hmm, our HR import has a legacy contact email on your record. @sara_it can you update the primary contact so 1Password can re-send?
sara_it: Updated contact to kevin@redwood.ai and reissued 1Password invite. Provisioner_bot: sent 1Password invite to kevin@redwood.ai
kevin: Invite received, but the invite link errors with "No seats available".
it-queue: it-queue: Seat pool low alert, seats=198/200? (this is a test message).
marco: That's odd, UI bug maybe. @elaine can you check seat assignment job?
elaine: Kicked the seat assignment worker. Log shows assign_user kevin success -> email sent. Try now.
kevin: Accepted 1Password, ok cool. Final: trying to enroll passkey on my iPhone for Okta device trust but the camera prompt for Face ID registration fails with "This passkey is already in use by another account".
marco: Are you using personal iCloud Keychain? Passkeys can collide if you previously registered a personal passkey for the same email alias. Which email was shown in the prompt?
kevin: It showed kevin.oldalias@personal.com initially (I had used that for a trial), then when I switched to corporate it still complained.
sara_it: Easiest path: we can clear the old passkey from the Okta side for your device and issue a one-time enrollment token, or you can remove the passkey from iPhone Settings -> Passwords manually. Which do you prefer?
kevin: I don't have local access to remove it easily. Could you clear it from your side?
marco: Cleared the stale passkey for kevin.oldalias@personal.com and generated an enrollment token valid 24h. Sent to kevin@redwood.ai.
kevin: Trying the token... enrollment successful! Device trust shows active.
kevin: Thanks everyone, first day hurdles mostly cleared. Appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
